elements.element: Customer is not subject to any restriction on soliciting employees of the counterparty.
elements.evidence: The clause expressly binds “neither party,” so Customer remains prohibited from soliciting covered employees.

elements.element: The non-solicitation restriction applies mutually to both parties.
elements.evidence: The clause provides that “neither party will solicit any person employed by the other party.”

elements.element: Covered personnel are limited to personnel directly involved in the services.
elements.evidence: The restriction applies only to an employee “who was directly involved in the performance of this Agreement.”

elements.element: The restriction ends no later than 12 months after the relevant personnel member’s involvement in the services ends.
elements.evidence: Although the clause includes 12 months following the end of the individual’s involvement, it also applies throughout the entire Term. If involvement ends more than 12 months before the Term ends, the restriction continues beyond the permitted 12-month period.

elements.element: General advertisements are excluded from prohibited solicitation.
elements.evidence: “Solicit” expressly excludes “generally advertising job openings” and follow-up with individuals responding to job advertisements.

elements.element: Unsolicited approaches by personnel are excluded from prohibited solicitation.
elements.evidence: “Solicit” expressly excludes activities involving individuals who “voluntarily initiate employment inquiries.”

elements.element: The clause does not prohibit hiring personnel absent prohibited solicitation.
elements.evidence: The operative prohibition addresses only solicitation to leave employment and contains no separate prohibition on hiring or employing an individual.

result.reason: The redline achieves mutuality, the directly involved personnel limitation, both required carve-outs, and avoids a no-hire restriction. However, retaining “During the Term” means the restriction can continue more than 12 months after an individual’s involvement ends, so the fallback duration requirement is not met. Deleting the Term-based duration would be necessary to reach the fallback cleanly.
